title: Jay Jieyi Shang
gallery_text: Passing By is a series of surrealist mixed-media paintings and photographs about memories, dreams, and changing urban spaces.

answers.interest: I’m interested in exploring how simulation, spatial intelligence, and digital twins can be used to test ideas and understand relationships within spatial systems. I’m also curious about how models shape the way we interpret environments, and how interactive spatial experiences can emerge from these computational systems.
